prompt: 32-line English battle rap: Round 1 Master Chief (cold futuristic 808 synth + Mjolnir shield hum, military precision), Beat Switch to Round 2 Kratos (thunderous Nordic war drums + heavy brass + deep gravel bass vocal), Final Round alternating 4/4/2/2/2/2 clash fusing 808s and war drums. Chief roasts Kratos's Olympus rage, graying Norse dad yelling BOY, rowing boats with Mimir, Mjolnir shields & MA5/Energy Sword vs blades, mashing circle QTEs. Kratos roasts Chief kidnapped at 6 in a UNSC lab, hiding in a green tin helmet puppet, failing to save Cortana & cloning The Weapon, Leviathan Axe shattering shields, 343 rebranding & Xbox losing exclusives vs God of War GOTY. Final clash: Ares chains & family ashes vs UNSC hardware, protector of humanity vs breaker of fate. Tight AABB, 11-14 syllables, savage punchlines.

variants.text:
[Round 1]
I step in like a cipher, your Olympus talks are old
Gray beard yelling BOY again, same tantrum, different mold
You row with Mimir talking, I move in silent sync
My shield hum says "stand down," your rage just starts to sink
Mjolnir mirror on my arm, your blades just scrape and cry
MA5 spits meaner heat than every myth you lie
Energy sword cuts clean, your axe just meets the steel
You mash the same old circle QTEs, I make the real
You call it godhood; I call it loud, then small
I keep humanity upright while you keep wrecking all
Your war cries sound like thunder trapped inside a dying room
Mine sound like locked orders turning enemies to tombs
You swing for fate and miss; I move with perfect pace
Cold visor, no emotion, just a target and a place

[Beat Switch]
[Round 2]
They dragged me from the lab at six, you were born from pain
Kid in a green tin helmet, they made a punchline chain
You say you lost the ones you love; I know that hollow tone
I watched Cortana slip away, then saw The Weapon clone
You talk about your axe like it rewrites the sky
Mine shattered every shield you built when I decided why
Leviathan splits your guard; your bragging needs a brace
Mine was war and exile, yours was just a broken face
You blame the gods, but I was caged by men and code
You brood on ash and prophecy; I walked the heavier road
343 kept changing masks, while you kept selling grief
Xbox lost whole worlds for that, you still call it relief
GOTY on your altar, but your legend's just a bruise
I save what’s left of home; you burn it to amuse

[Final Clash]
Ares chains and family ashes, that’s your favorite prayer
I got UNSC hardware, built to put truth in air
You are breaker of fate, yes, but only for your own
I’m protector of humanity, the shield that won’t be thrown
You shout for blood; I stay composed, that’s the gap
Your thunder hits the void while mine maps every trap
I wear the war you started and return it to your throat
You chase one more redemption while I keep my people afloat
variants.title: Split The Helm
tags: Battle rap with a cold futuristic 808 synth foundation in Round 1, then a beat switch into thunderous Nordic war drums, heavy brass, and a deep gravel bass vocal for Round 2; final round fuses 808s and war drums in an alternating 4/4/2/2/2/2 clash. Verse one is clipped and surgical, verse two lands slower and heavier, final section alternates snarling doubles and group-shout ad-libs. Airlock risers, shield-hum flickers, axe-whip swells, and impact silences keep the transitions sharp. Bright, punishing, chest-rattling mix.

variants.text:
[Round 1]
You swing at Olympus, still mad at the gods,
I lock the grid tight, then I step through the odds.
Gray-bearded dad, yelling BOY like a threat,
I hear bedtime in it, not the death that you get.
You row with Mimir like a tour-guide crew,
I keep shields up, then I circle on you.
MA5 in my hand, your axe meets the steel,
Energy sword glows, I still make it kneel.
You mash circle prompts like the fate’s on repeat,
I ghost every trap with a soldier’s clean feet.
My armor hums calm, your rage comes unglued,
You brought old revenge, I brought war to your mood.
I’m built for the storm, you’re a prayer with a bruise,
I save whole worlds while you pick your abuse.

[Beat Switch]
[Round 2]
Kidnapped at six, in a lab with the lime,
They built you for shock, I was made for the climb.
You hide in that green tin, like a puppet in pain,
I wear mine with purpose, you wear yours like a chain.
Cortana slipped once, now you sing that same loss,
I face what I lose, I still pay the cost.
You clone “The Weapon” like grief needs a spare,
I meet the real void and I stay right there.
Your shields crack apart when my Leviathan swings,
I turn your whole legend to splinters and rings.
God of War got the shine, but the crown still fell,
I’ve seen franchises choke while I’m built to repel.
You fight for a title, I fight for a race,
You rage at the screen, I erase your last trace.

[Final Round]
Ares on chains, your whole house in ash,
UNSC hardware, I turn it to trash.
Protector of worlds.
Breaker of fate.
I stand for the many.
You drown in your hate.
Chief with the steel.
Kratos with grief.
I end your crusade.
You beg for relief.
You shout at the void.
I answer with force.
Humanity lives.
You die by your course.

Verse 1 rides clipped military precision, verse 2 hits slower and heavier, final clash tightens with shouted doubles, delay throws on punch words, and hard risers into each round break. Bright, brutal, cinematic mix
